coverage.threshold_rule: At least 3 distinct dated comparable observations spanning at least 90 days from at least 2 independent origins, or a verified continuous price series covering at least 90 days.

limitations: Only one price observation was verified on a fetched page: OzBargain deal post 981957 (David Jones, A$139, RRP A$349, post dated 2026-11-06). Its page header shows 'out of stock', so current availability is unknown.
No price for the previous Black Friday window (2025-11-28 to 2025-11-29) was verified. No dated Black Friday 2025 price for this exact NA342/00 model was found.
The Good Guys Black Friday price (A$148, 'Deal ends 02/12/26') appeared only in search snippets. The fetched page did not render the price, so the deal end date is not documented by a fetched page.
Harvey Norman's A$139 and Black Friday A$148 listings and the JB Hi-Fi A$149 sale were seen only in snippets; their dates are unknown.
camelcamelcamel AU (Amazon low A$140.50 on 2026-11-16) could not be fetched; its figures are unverified leads.
Not accessed or not established: PriceHipster, StaticICE, PriceHound, and the full GetPrice history. No continuous price-history series was obtained for any AU retailer.
Several candidate retailers (Amazon AU current listing, Officeworks, Kmart, Bunnings) were not checked directly; pages in fetch-failure list were not re-fetched.
Excluded as non-matching or non-AUD: OzBargain Philips 5000 Series deals (different model), PriceSpy NZ (NZD), Tradeinn (USD), Coolblue and Geizhals (EUR), IM Trading (USD), Farmers NZ (NZD).
Shipping and tax basis were not established for the verified observation (the post says 'Delivered / C&C / In-Store' without a stated amount).
Search and fetch budgets were exhausted (6 searches, 3 fetches), limiting verification of the off-season window (2025-11-29 to 2026-11-26).
Internet Archive: checked 6 archived snapshot(s) of jbhifi.com.au, getprice.com.au, thegoodguys.com.au; 5 dated prices read from structured page data.
No current price was entered and no current offer could be verified.
